script.title: Tilt Management: Stop One Mistake Becoming Five
script.hook: Your worst call comes right after a bad one
script.narration: The most dangerous decision you make today might be the one right after a bad one. Poker players call it tilt. Frustration from one loss leaks into the next choices and makes them worse. You replay the mistake. You speed up to feel in control. You take a bigger risk to win it all back in one move. One mistake becomes five. The fix is not willpower. It is a rule that runs automatically. Here is one: no irreversible decisions within an hour of a major setback. Another is naming it out loud. Saying we're a bit tilted gives the whole team permission to slow down. A bad outcome is information, not an emergency. The full guide by Chase Arenella is linked below.
captions: The fix is a rule, not willpower
No irreversible calls for an hour
Say it out loud: we're tilted
